//ConnectionStrings: Deliberately empty. These are secrets and never belong in a versioned file.
Server:       set the environment variable ConnectionStrings__CustomerReviewSystemDataOLAP (double underscore).
//Load: Phase L. Overridden per run with: --phase Extract | Load | Full (default Full).
MinKeywordFrequency: a lemma seen fewer times than this in the whole corpus is not written
to Dimenciones.PalabraClave. Set it to 1 to keep every lemma.
DateDimensionPaddingYears: extra whole years added after the last date found in staging.

Csv.//BaseDirectory: Empty means: search upwards from the executable for 'CSV opiniones de clientes'.

Api.//BaseUrl: Must match the https profile in the Api project's launchSettings.json.
Api.//ApiKey: Secret. Same value configured in the Api project. Set with: dotnet user-secrets set "Sources:Api:ApiKey" "<key>"
